AGENDA
  SENIOR SERVICES COMMITTEE
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
 Welcome to the meeting of the Senior Services Committee. Meetings are open to the public and
 held at the Adult Recreation Center at 201 E. Colorado Street, Glendale, CA 91205. Meeting
 minutes will be available for viewing on the City Website at
 https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal. If you have any question about
 matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact (818) 548-3715 during regular
 business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES DURING THE MEETING.
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration
 Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish
 to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the Community
 Services & Parks Administration Office at (818) 548-2782, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled
 meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
 provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
 in their native language.
  MARCH 25, 2021 AT 3:00 PM

Due to the evolving situation with the COVID-19 novel coronavirus and health recommendations from
the LA County Health Department, the Senior Services Committee meeting will be available to the
public electronically.

Due to social distancing requirements, the public will not be able to attend the meeting. The public is
encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social distancing.

The meeting can be viewed:
On local cable: Charter Cable Channel 6 and AT&T U-verse Channel 99.
Streaming Online: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal

For public comments and questions during the meeting call (818) 937-8100.
 City staff will be submitting these questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person
during the Senior Services Committee meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the March 25,
  2021, quarterly meeting of the Senior Services Committee was posted on or before March
  18, 2021, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
  2. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Recognition of outgoing Chair, Camille Levee of the Senior Services Committee
  from 2018-2020
  b. Introduction of new Committee Member, Police Services Officer Amy Tate
  3. COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS
  4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5)
  minutes. The Committee may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision. The
  Director or designee may refer the matter to the proper section for investigation and report.
  5. CONSENT ITEMS
  a. Approval of the Minutes of the Senior Services Committee meeting held on
  November 16, 2019.
  6. REPORTS - INFORMATION ONLY
  a. Senior Services Unit COVID-19 Update
  7. ADJOURNMENT
